svg.title: Tempered microstructure progression
svg.desc: As-quenched martensite to ferrite plus cementite

text.tspan: Carbide particles: none resolved → finer → coarser → large spheres
Matrix: tetragonal martensite → low-carbon martensite → BCC ferrite
Hardness/strength ↓, toughness/ductility ↑ ; ends similar to spheroidized structure (ferrite + cementite)
Retained austenite (450–750 °F range) transforms to lower bainite – lecture statement.
